import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
entry=pathlib.Path('docs/DevDocs/assets/20o-b2-freeze-d/entry-20261105')
load=lambda path:json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha=lambda data:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
canon=lambda value:json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
b=load(entry/'signature-baseline.json')
raw=pathlib.Path(b['draft']['file']).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
lines=raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
index=b['draft']['status_line_number']-1
body=b''.join(line for i,line in enumerate(lines) if i!=index)
assert sha(body)==b['draft']['body_sha256']
before=(entry/b['draft']['before_snapshot']).read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
assert len(before)==len(lines) and sum(a!=c for a,c in zip(before,lines))==1
assert lines[index].decode().rstrip('\n')==b['draft']['allowed_status_line_after']
assert sha(raw)==load(entry/'signature-transition.json')['draft']['after_full_sha256']
ledger=load(pathlib.Path(b['ledger']['file']))
assert ledger['f_d_signature_status']=='signed' and ledger['joint_freeze_activated'] and not ledger['product_implementation_started']
assert sha(canon(ledger['items']))==b['ledger']['decision_items_sha256']
assert (entry/'ledger-after-signature.json').read_bytes()==pathlib.Path(b['ledger']['file']).read_bytes()
receipts=load(entry/'decision-receipts.json')['receipts']
assert len(receipts)==3 and all(r['answer']=='批准' and r['valid_for_activation'] and not r['conditional'] for r in receipts)
for i,r in enumerate(receipts):
    assert json.loads(r['question_item_id'])==['request_user_input_async','call_6898d1976bb04b74a4040604f280685b',i]
changed=subprocess.check_output(['cmd','/c','git','diff','--name-only','22a865bc','--','docs/UseDocs']).decode().splitlines()
assert changed==['docs/UseDocs/library/cmath.md'] and 'status: planned' in pathlib.Path(changed[0]).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'body_sha256':sha(body),'only_line_changed':index+1,'decision_items_unchanged':True,'signature_status':'signed','joint_freeze_activated':True,'product_started':False,'usedocs_allowed_files':changed}))
